gate_1_the_bound_holds_on_fresh_draws.claim: the model's rows and offset are within the derived bound of the host's on every draw, in both dtypes
gate_1_the_bound_holds_on_fresh_draws.case: tests/control/test_allocator_objectives.py::test_the_models_rows_and_offset_are_the_hosts[float32] and [float64], nothing planted: the probe's clean arms (50 runs a dtype), 20 local runs of the whole file, CI's stress

prediction.value: 0 failing of 100 clean probe runs and of 20 local runs of the file
prediction.basis: derived (a worst case of the linearised rounding of every operation on the path) and measured-before (worst 0.285 of it at 72 points in float32)
prediction.why: the bound counts each rounding at its largest, |delta| = u, with its sensitivity's sign taken; the realised roundings reach about a tenth of that

gate_1_the_bound_holds_on_fresh_draws.metric: u sum_k |dR/d delta_k| per element: the realised roundings put into the same sum reproduce the measured error to 0.11 %

control.plant: AP3_PLANT=coefficient: one source of each coil off by 5e-5 of its coefficient in the model, 10x the resolution of 4.9e-6

gate_1_the_bound_holds_on_fresh_draws.if_wrong: a clean failure is either an operation the path has and the bound does not count (rebuild the emulation's bits at the draw), or a draw whose element the first-order sum misses (compare the realised reconstruction there); never a widened factor
gate_1_the_bound_holds_on_fresh_draws.cannot_discriminate_if: the control is not caught (the bound would then be too loose to say anything at the coefficient's scale)

gate_2_the_coefficient_control_fires_eve.claim: with one source of each coil off by 5e-5 of its coefficient in the model, the rows test fails on every run, in both dtypes, and never with nothing planted
gate_2_the_coefficient_control_fires_eve.case: the same node, AP3_PLANT=coefficient, detection_rate.py with --hypothesis-seed: four arms of 25 runs (two a dtype)

prediction.value: 50/50 caught a dtype; clean 0/50 a dtype
prediction.basis: derived from the resolution (the plant is 10x it) and measured-before (|change| / bound at least 9.3 on 800 Hypothesis draws when scaled to 5e-5)
prediction.why: every draw has an element whose planted change is many times its bound; a run of 25 draws is caught by its first

gate_2_the_coefficient_control_fires_eve.if_wrong: read the missed seed: a miss is a draw where no element's change passes its bound; measure that draw's ratio before any change
gate_2_the_coefficient_control_fires_eve.cannot_discriminate_if: both arms fail or both pass
